hostPermissions.label: Add servers on this computer
hostPermissions.description: Browse host folders, install software, and create or import servers. Only the local owner can grant this trusted host access.

groups.label: Settings
groups.description: Configure this server's identity and resource settings.

permissions.label: Can View Server
permissions.description: See this server in the panel. Required for every other permission on this server.

permissions.label: Edit server settings
permissions.description: Change the server name, player address, port, memory, and server list message. Startup executables and server removal remain owner-only.

groups.label: Control
groups.description: Console access and server power controls.

permissions.label: Console
permissions.description: View output and run unrestricted Minecraft commands, including stopping the server and changing operators. Grant only to trusted server administrators. Power permissions separately control the panel buttons.

permissions.label: Start
permissions.description: Start the server when it is offline. Uploaded mods, plugins and scripts run with the host computer user’s access; grant file changes only to people you trust with that computer.

permissions.label: Stop
permissions.description: Stop a running server.

permissions.label: Restart
permissions.description: Restart the server. Uploaded mods, plugins and scripts run with the host computer user’s access; grant file changes only to people you trust with that computer.

groups.label: Players
groups.description: Player lists and game access without unrestricted console commands.

permissions.label: View player records
permissions.description: Read player names, UUIDs, login history, whitelist, operators and ban reasons.

permissions.label: Manage whitelist
permissions.description: View player records and add or remove whitelist entries, or enable the whitelist. Does not grant operators or unrestricted console commands.

groups.label: User
groups.description: Manage access for people helping with this server.

permissions.label: View users
permissions.description: View people with access to this server.

permissions.label: Create users
permissions.description: Add and invite people with permissions you also have.

permissions.label: Update users
permissions.description: Change a subuser's permissions, within your own access.

permissions.label: Delete users
permissions.description: Revoke a subuser's access to this server.

groups.label: Files
groups.description: Browse and manage the server's files.

permissions.label: List files
permissions.description: View folders, file information and recycled server files.

permissions.label: Read and download files
permissions.description: Open file contents and download server files.

permissions.label: Create and upload files
permissions.description: Create, upload and restore server files from Recycle Bin. Replacing existing files also requires Edit and Delete files. Together with Start or Restart, this allows uploaded mods, plugins or scripts to execute code with the host computer user’s access.

permissions.label: Edit files
permissions.description: Change the contents of existing files. Together with Start or Restart, this allows uploaded mods, plugins or scripts to execute code with the host computer user’s access.

permissions.label: Delete files
permissions.description: Move files and folders to Recycle Bin, or permanently remove recycled files.

groups.label: Backups
groups.description: Manage backup archives and automatic schedules.

permissions.label: View backups
permissions.description: View backup archives, their status and recycled backup archives.

permissions.label: Create backups
permissions.description: Create backups and recover backup archives from Recycle Bin without extracting them into the server.

permissions.label: Download backups
permissions.description: Download existing backup archives.

permissions.label: Restore backups
permissions.description: Replace a stopped server's files with a saved backup.

permissions.label: Delete backups
permissions.description: Move backup archives to Recycle Bin or permanently delete recycled backup archives.

permissions.label: Manage backup schedules
permissions.description: Change automatic backup timing and retention.

permissions.label: Change backup location
permissions.description: Reserved for the local computer owner. Browsing host folders is not delegated with server admin permissions.

permissions.label: View audit logs
permissions.description: Read and search recorded server activity.
